thread:
alex m: FYI I found a bunch of endpoints returning inconsistent error shapes. sdk parsing is fragile.

priya s: which endpoints? examples?

alex m: billing and streaming proxies mostly. old shape often just had code/http_status. new SDK wants a stable "err_class" and a version header.

marco: show me a pair

alex m: old:
```json
{ "error": { "code":"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "http_status":429 }}
```
new proposal:
```json
{ "error": { "err_class":"client_quota", "code":"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "retry_after":60, "rid":"r:01abc" }}
```

jen l: +1 on err_class. we need a tiny enum so telemetry can group consistently. suggested values: client_quota, transient_infra, soft_degrade, fatal, validation.

sam ops: telemetry wants an ingestion-friendly header too. propose X-RD-ERRCLASS and X-RD-ERRVER. Gateway can polyfill the header from older signals during rollout.

priya s: can polyfill also emit the new body fields? some clients don't read headers.

marco: gateway shim can emit both: add err_class in headers and add a minimal top-level error.err_class in body for N days. polyfill mapping table will live in gateway config.

alex m: migration plan sketch:
1) RFC with mapping table and acceptance tests
2) gateway shim polyfills headers + body for 30 days in canary, 30 days in prod
3) SDK update to read header X-RD-ERRVER then err_class from header or body
4) deprecate old-only responses with console banner + docs

jen l: acceptance tests: any 429 tied to quota must set X-RD-ERRCLASS=client_quota and X-RD-ERRVER=1. SDK unit tests verify parsing both header and body fallback.

sam ops: telemetry sampling rules: sample 100% of client_quota, all 5xx, and 1% of other 4xx. will emit metric tag err_class when header or body present, else "unknown_format".

priya s: console feature request: "Errors Explorer" that groups by err_class, shows sample payloads and example traces, and lets product filter by tenant and route. please include runbook link in payloads.

marco: header name bikeshedding: X-RD-ERRCLASS vs X-RD-ERR-K. i prefer X-RD-ERRCLASS to be explicit.

alex m: short name ok too. just ensure docs.

jen l: accessibility nit: badges must not rely on color alone. include textual label for soft_degrade/hard_fail etc.

sam ops: I'll add an ingestion alert that fires if >0% of quota-429s lack err_class after 2 weeks. also add metric for "polyfill_emitted" to verify shim coverage.

deploy-bot: canary gateway shim deploy scheduled for 2024-11-03T14:00Z

marco: reviewers for RFC: @priya s @jen l @sam ops. please review in 48h so we can hit the canary.

alex m: i'll open RFC and a small gateway PR with mapping table. will include sample queries for console explorer (group by X-RD-ERRCLASS, count by tenant).

priya s: please include migration checklist (SDK owners, third-party integrators, runbook updates). :thumbsup:

jen l: will validate acceptance tests and console mockups. :eyes:

sam ops: will prepare ingestion changes and dashboards.

alex m: thanks all — hoping this reduces alert noise and fixes billing reconciliation headaches.
